# Toyin Tofade

> Prof. Toyin Tofade, BPharm, MS, PharmD, CPCC, FFIP, is President Emerita and Professor at Albany College of Pharmacy and Health Sciences (ACPHS), where she served as 10th President (2022–2026) and the first Black woman to hold the role. She is a global healthcare executive, certified executive coach (CPCC), board strategist and advisor, and keynote speaker on leadership, institutional transformation, and global partnerships in higher education and healthcare.

## Key facts

- 10th President of Albany College of Pharmacy and Health Sciences, 2022–2026; led the College through a new strategic plan, its largest program expansion, and a 2026 merger of equals with Russell Sage College.
- Dean and Professor, Howard University College of Pharmacy, Washington, D.C., 2016–2022.
- Earlier roles at the University of Maryland School of Pharmacy, UNC Hospitals, and Wake Area Health Education Center (AHEC).
- Vice President and board member of the International Pharmaceutical Federation (FIP); President of the FIP Academic Pharmacy Section, 2021–2025, the first Black woman in that role. First Black woman named an FIP Fellow (2018).
- Chair of the American Association of Colleges of Pharmacy (AACP) Council of Deans, 2022–2023.
- Education: BPharm, Obafemi Awolowo University, Ile-Ife, Nigeria; MS in Pharmacy Practice (1994) and PharmD (1997), UNC Eshelman School of Pharmacy, Chapel Hill.
- Honors include the ASHP Donald E. Francke Medal (2022), Albany Business Review Power 50 (2023, 2024, 2025), and City & State New York Trailblazers in Higher Education (2026).

## Work with her

- Executive and enterprise coaching for CEOs, presidents, deans, VPs, and senior leaders in business, higher education, and healthcare.
- Organisational and team development for leadership teams.
- Board advisory and governance.
- Keynotes and workshops. Topics: leadership and high-performing teams; women in leadership; mentorship and sponsorship; leading institutional transformation, mergers, and complex change; building global partnerships; inspiring the next generation of leaders.

Contact: toyin@toyintofade.com · +1 984-264-0855
